in_marathi.name: Padam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lotus, Symbol of Creator
in_marathi.long_meaning: Padam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Padam is derived from the Sanskrit word 'padma', meaning lotus. In Hindu mythology, the lotus is a symbol of creation and is often associated with the god Vishnu. It represents purity, enlightenment, and the divine connection between the physical and spiritual worlds.
